g.text: URD-1 / ReturnOps AU User Requirement Traceability Diagram
SysML/UML Requirement Model — Traceability Descent from Informal Needs to Operational Use Cases, Specifications, and Governing Invariants
Level 1: Informal Stakeholder Requirements (AH-* / Criterion C1)
Level 2: Operational Use Cases (UC-* / Criterion C3)
Level 3: Formal System Specifications (FR-* Functional & NFR-* Non-Functional)
Level 4: Governing Business Rules & Invariants (BR-* / Report §2.1.2 & §16)
"Let me describe the return or product issue
"Execute only the exact approved simulated action
and never perform it twice by accident."
"Show material source conflicts; if they prevent
a safe proposal, stop and hand the case to me."
FR-001 | Customer return submission & free-text intake
FR-002 | Extract facts & identify missing evidence
FR-005 | Targeted clarification; no fixed round cap
NFR-003 | Synthetic data; customer PII redaction
FR-009 | Human approval for high-impact actions
FR-010 | Exactly-once simulated return & label ops
FR-011 | Append-only audit logging per Invariant 5
NFR-002 | Zero domain write/side effects before gate
NFR-004 | Zero duplicate effects; replay recovery
OF-004 | Independent logistics sandbox adapter (Member A)
FR-006 | Retrieve passages with source citations
NFR-009 | Untrusted input cannot alter policy/authority
OF-001 | Multi-modal image observation extraction (Member C)
BR-009 | Single order, single return parcel, no split shipments
BR-011 | Desk evidence, targets & results separately labelled
BR-004 | Mock/sandbox only; never moves real money
BR-006 | Internal approval AND provider permission required
BR-007 | Changed scope/amount requires fresh human approval
BR-010 | Stored simulated results & notification required
BR-012 | AI cannot write authoritative state or run tools
BR-001 | Conditional guidance only; no legal determination
BR-002 | Conflicts visible; unresolved conflicts ESCALATE
BR-005 | Model confidence cannot bypass missing evidence/risk
